user.title: Who is this for?
user.description:
Predictive Bedtime learns when someone goes to sleep from their work schedule and their bed, then predicts upcoming bedtimes so the home can get ready ahead of time.

Add one entry per person.

sources.title: Where to learn from
sources.description: Pick {name}'s work calendars and the bed sensor for their side of the bed.

data_description.calendars: Every timed event on these calendars is treated as a shift. All-day events are ignored. Shift changes and swaps are picked up automatically.
data_description.bed_sensor: On while {name} is in bed. A stretch of 3 hours or more counts as a night's sleep; shorter ones are ignored.

habits.title: Starting habits
habits.description: These guide predictions until enough nights have been learned. After that, {name}'s actual bedtimes take over. They can be changed later under Configure.

data.free_bedtime: Usual bedtime with no shift nearby

data_description.wind_down_minutes: How early the Wind-down sensor turns on, for dimming lights or cooling the bedroom.

abort.already_configured: This person is already set up.

data.free_bedtime: Usual bedtime with no shift nearby
data.unwind_minutes: Shortest time from shift end to bed
data.settle_minutes: Time in bed before it counts as a sleep attempt
data.wake_gap_minutes: Time out of bed before it counts as awake
data.min_sleep_hours: Shortest stretch that counts as a night

data_description.target_sleep_hours: Used until enough nights have been learned; after that, actual behaviour wins.
data_description.learning_window_days: Nights older than this are discarded. Within the window, recent nights count more.
